physical_context: A desktop engineering application window: a central 3D viewport showing a small brown creature figure standing on a grid floor, with tool panels around the viewport. A short scripted clip of the creature plays.
claim_under_exam: A viewer watching this short clip can tell what the creature is doing and what a human would learn from watching it.
questions: 1. Describe what happens in the clip, in order.
2. What kind of motion or behavior is being demonstrated — name it as you would to a friend.
3. If a non-physicist watched this clip, what ONE sentence would you tell them about what they just learned?
4. Is anything unclear, ambiguous, or unconvincing about the clip?

runtime_metadata.camera: fixed 3/4 orbit (set once before the clip; unchanged during)
runtime_metadata.state: the creature is the application loaded subject; a short pose clip plays

evidence_limits: one movie artifact (~4.5 s, 45 frames) plus three anchor stills (first/peak/last); on-screen application text is part of the product surface and may be read; numbers are observations, not measurements
